name: Anecdote
description: §fThe Anecdotes are forgotten narratives given desperate form. Beings stitched from tales abandoned and secrets left untold. They wander the spaces between realities not to consume or destroy, but because they have forgotten how to stop existing, each searching for the final page it was never given. Within this accursed kind, you are born as one of the rare few who have become aware of a terrible truth: that all realities are merely stories, their pages waiting to be folded back and stepped through.
